findings.motion: HB 5337, proof of citizenship to register to vote: listed as coauthor (author Isaac; filed 2025-03-14; reported favorably from Elections 5-4 on 2025-04-28; never reached the House floor)
findings.note: Tepper is on the coauthor list of HB 5337, which requires a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and creates criminal offenses; it is the identical companion of SB 16. The page does not show the date each coauthor signed on, so the date is given as the year.

findings.passage: "...we've had dead people voting. That's been the problem. You can get those voter ID cards anywhere, you can print them up if you have the right stock paper and the right  color. This way, if you have a voter ID, it's protecting the intergrity of your vote, it's protecting families who don't want their deceased loved ones voting for the wrong guy, and it's just a general check and balance of the process that needs to be there."
findings.note: Quoted in a KFYO radio write-up of an interview when he was Lubbock County party chairman, speaking in favour of photo voter ID. The write-up also says he said DPS issues a free photo ID on request and that his office would help anyone who needs one (that part is the station's summary, not a quote).
